All Type Of Liquidity Explained In SMC & ICT Part -2 | Stop Getting Trapped By Big Players 

🔍 Liquidity Part 2 | Internal, Time-Based & Candle Liquidity Traps EXPLAINED

If you've watched Liquidity Part 1, you already know how crucial liquidity is to understand Smart Money movement.
But in this Part 2, we go even deeper into the hidden traps and zones that most retail traders completely miss!

📈 These advanced liquidity concepts will change how you look at charts forever.


---

📚 What You’ll Learn in This Video:

✅ How Low & High Resistance Liquidity tells you where the market will move FAST or go slow
✅ How Internal and External Liquidity controls the flow of Smart Money
✅ How to use Candle-based Liquidity (Daily, Weekly, Monthly) to find daily bias
✅ The hidden truth behind Time-Based Liquidity:
→ Asian, London, New York & London Close session traps
✅ What are Equal Highs / Lows and why they are always targeted
✅ Deep dive into Buy Side & Sell Side Liquidity
✅ BONUS: Explained Liquidity Voids, Liquidity Sweeps, and Liquidity Runs


---

📌 These are the very concepts that institutions and hedge funds use to trap uninformed traders.

If you're serious about trading with Smart Money Concepts (SMC) or ICT, this video is non-negotiable.
No more guessing, no more getting trapped — it's time to trade with logic.
